profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer @ Roblox
profile.summary:
With over two decades as a Software Engineer, I've built extensive experience across the technology spectrum—from nimble startups (Traiter, Hall, Orchestra, Asyncast) to mid-sized companies (Atlassian) and global corporations (HP, Palm).

I've embraced multifaceted roles demanding deep involvement in all aspects of software development, team building, leadership, and mentoring. Technical foundation in infrastructure, mobile, web, and desktop apps—equipped to solve cross-platform challenges at scale. I hold 3 patents and served as a technical editor for a published book.

My passion lies in building high-impact, cutting-edge technology that makes a meaningful difference in the world. I take pride in creating beautiful user interactions backed by resilient designs. I love crafting delightful experiences that positively touch people's lives.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Created the features Template Boards/Gallery, emoji reactions, and board/card views for
Trello.
• Deeply involved in contributing to the core backend services, ensuring high performance
and reliability of the Trello platform.
• GDPR & RTBF compliance.
• Full-stack development of the HipChat DataCenter product (on-prem hosted version).
• Contributed to and led a team to build the HipChat DataCenter Migration Service enabling
the on-demand user upgrade from single node to multi-node deployments.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Acquired by Atlassian.

• Built out engineering and design teams from 1 to 14 employees across roles for backend,
mobile (iOS / Android / Windows Phone), web front end, and lead of design.
• Responsible for all development and production operations including security, server
provisioning, monitoring and alerting, continuous integration, and triage.
• Designed and implemented a scalable and highly available real time messaging delivery
system. Built a real time streaming twitter service using Node.js, RabbitMQ, and Redis.
• Integrated a Neo4j graph cluster for promoting user connection recommendations.
• Built Windows and Linux versions of the Hall desktop application using Qt. Assisted on iOS
UI and network/API management.
• Created a chatbot that guided users through onboarding and other informational tasks.

Tech: Node.js, Ruby on Rails, Objective-C, RabbitMQ, MongoDB, Elasticsearch,
PostgreSQL, Redis, Neo4j, AWS

patents.title: System and method for serving a message client
patents.description: A system and method for synchronizing messages between client application instances and a message service provider includes a connection service communicatively coupled to a plurality of client messaging application instances; a first intermediary transfer layer with an inbound message data queue that queues message updates of a client application instance and an outbound message data queue that queues message updates and notifications from a mailbox service layer; a mailbox service layer communicatively coupled to the connection service through the first intermediary transfer layer; a second intermediary transfer layer with an mailbox message data queue that contains queued message data directed at the mailbox service layer and a message service data queue that contains queued message updates directed at a message service layer; and a message service layer configured for message interactions with an outside message service provider.

patents.title: Identifying relevant content in email
patents.description: Message management services can include processing an email to identify relevant content from among all content in the email and converting the identified relevant content into a simple, easy-to-read format. For example, message management services can apply multiple parsing strategies to an email. Each strategy can attempt to parse the email to identify relevant content and to output results that include any identified relevant content and an associated confidence score. The results having the highest confidence score can be selected. The identified relevant content included in the selected results can be converted into a flat string with stylings and links for displaying relevant content of the email in a simple, easy-to-read format.
